_about: What a generator earns: the figures the page shows for the months of the public hourly file (site/public/seller/erw_2026_generator_hourly.csv: ERCOT solar at HB_HUBAVG in real time, 2018-07 to 2026-10-03; the last twelve months 2025-10 to 2026-09), each with its check key (the page's check-values key, or the scenario's named cell) and the tolerance to which the replication must meet it (half of the page's last shown digit). Read from a built page's data cells by session 582 (docs/reviews/replications-2026-10-22.md); the NPV is at solar's 0.7 percent degradation (since session 298).
